ModelValidatorExternal.release_notes:
###  Grid Voltage Frequency Ratio (VFR) Tests

- **New Voltage Frequency Ratio Test.** Added support for a new VFratio test event, automatically triggered when a `.plb` profile contains changes to both voltage and frequency. Existing `.plb` file configuration is unaffected — the same format used for standard PLB profiles applies.
- **PSCAD Templates Updated for VFR Test.** PSCAD templates v2.0.2 and v2.0.3 now include a dedicated logic for handling voltage frequency ratios.

### New PSCAD Templates

- **PSCAD Templates v2.0.2 and v2.0.3.** Two new PSCAD template versions are available, offering different Three-Phase Voltage Source Models. The previous versions of PSCAD templates has been removed.

### Bug Fixes

- **Rectified the bug where `.plb` file not being read entirely.** A bug related to last line of `.plb` event file not being read by the PSCAD template for simulations has been fixed.
- **Addition of two generic models to dyr database.** REGCC and REECE models has been added to model database.

ModelValidator.release_notes:
### PSSE Suite Controller

- **Load-Based Channel Selection.** The PSSE Suite Controller can now build channel/plot selections from Loads, alongside the existing Machines, Buses, and PPC options.

### Test Suite Selection

- **Test Selection Now Persists Across Restarts.** Previously, selecting a subset of tests in a test suite (via the row checkboxes) was forgotten every time Model Validator was closed and reopened — all tests reverted to selected. Your selection is now saved with the test suite and restored the next time it's opened, so you no longer need to re-select tests for every session.

### Batch Report Generation

- **Select a Plot Configuration Sheet Per Test Suite When Batch-Generating Reports.** The Global Report Generation section (in the Testsuite/Pipeline Manager) now shows a checkbox for each plot-configuration sheet available in a test suite's report config (e.g. PSCAD DMAT, PSSE DMAT, Benchmarking), so you can choose which sheet(s) to generate for each suite in one place — without opening every suite's own report dialog individually. A suite can generate reports for more than one sheet in the same run.
- **Report Filenames Now Reflect the Sheet Used.** When generating reports for a specific plot-configuration sheet, the output filename now includes the sheet name, so reports from different sheets for the same test suite no longer overwrite each other.

### Bug Fixes

- **Plot Reports Now Show the Actual SCR/XR Value Instead of "POC".** When SCR Pre-Fault, SCR Post-Fault, or XR Ratio was set to use the project's Point-of-Connection setting, plot reports previously displayed the literal text "POC" for SCR Pre-Fault and SCR Post-Fault instead of the actual value being used. All three fields now correctly show the resolved value.
